$comment: The open-call record contract. Enforced by scripts/build-registry.mjs, which is the only validator — there is no JSON Schema runtime in this repository and no dependency is added for one.
$rule: A blank field is a finding; a fabricated one is a defect. Every product-register field names the record it came from or it is blank. Nothing is filled in from memory, inferred from a programme's usual cycle, or carried over from last year.
$history: Until 2026-08-29 this contract governed only closes and award, and left summary, eligibility, effort, kind and cycle unguarded — four of them enum-checked, which made them read as validated. That gap was found by this project's own Q4-PROVENANCE audit and closed here.

basis.confirmed: read off the organisation's own page by a human, on the date in `read`.
basis.sourced: read off the named third party in `from`, on the date in `read`. Primary confirmation is still owed.
basis.derived: transformed from a named source rather than quoted from it — `rule` states the transformation. Used where this schema's vocabulary does not exist in the source, so the mapping is this repository's and must be visible as such.
basis.none: no record exists. The field is blank and `why` carries a ⟦FILL⟧ marker naming what is owed. A populated field with basis none is the defect this contract exists to prevent.

notes.summary: A description of a programme is a claim about it. Quoted from the source with a basis, or null. Every record is currently null: none was ever read verbatim.
notes.eligibility: `stated` is the constraint as the source words it. The three enum arrays are a derivation from `stated` into this schema's vocabulary and carry basis `derived`, never `sourced` — the source does not use these categories.
notes.requirements: What an application costs to assemble: essays, recommendations, work_sample, endorsement, fee_usd, and `stated` as the source words it. `effort` is DERIVED from this at read time and is never stored on a record — an effort grading with no requirements behind it is an opinion, and it is the denominator of the ranking.
notes.award: min/max null when no figure was read. basis follows the same four values.
notes.kind: Classification into this schema's vocabulary, so basis is `derived`, not `sourced`.
notes.cycle: Blank unless a source established it. Not inferred from the programme's name or reputation.
notes.stage: Workflow stage; must be a stage id in data/workflow.json. Internal, not a product claim.
notes.drafts: [{ label, href, state }]. A label and a link, never a person. No applicant-identifying content belongs in a record.
